gates.name: Reliability Fail-Closed Gating
gates.explanation: Genuinely degraded sensor hardware / communication failure triggers immediate fail-closed alert.

gates.name: Physical Quiet Background Check
gates.explanation: Quiet healthy window with no physical disturbance detected on healthy sensor.

gates.name: Conflicting Evidence / High Uncertainty Gating
gates.explanation: Physical disturbance is present, but evidence is conflicting, degraded, or uncertain.

gates.name: Vessel Association Corroboration Check
gates.explanation: Physical disturbance is present, but uncorroborated by vessel association.

gates.name: High-Confidence Escalation Gate
gates.explanation: Strong physical and vessel corroboration with low uncertainty escalates to T3; else T2.
